The main takeaway from our work is that

the formation of platelet–monocyte complexes may contribute to the development of HIV-1-associated neurocognitive disorders, and that antiplatelet therapies may have a role in the prevention and/or treatment of these disorders.
platelet–monocyte interactions may be a novel therapeutic target for HIV-1–related cognitive impairment.
